The issuer generates significant revenue ($11.0B) but faces severe financial distress, evidenced by negative operating income (-$459M), negative net income (-$640M), and an extremely leveraged balance sheet with $11.8B in total liabilities against just $415M in shareholders' equity (total debt/equity ratio is extremely high). While liquidity appears manageable in the short term with current assets exceeding current liabilities, the high leverage and unprofitability place the company deep in speculative grade territory with substantial credit risk.

DECISION: B-
